stem: How did the United States respond to the Soviet blockade of Berlin in 1948?

options.label: A
options.text: The United States started economic sanctions that limited trade with the Soviet Union.

options.label: B
options.text: The United States used newly developed tanks to deliver weapons to Allied armies.

options.label: C
options.text: The United States airlifted supplies to prevent starvation in Allied territory.

options.label: D
options.text: The United States placed an embargo on goods from the Soviet Union.
